nodes.label: Family-size retention confirmed
nodes.source_location: Retain family size in separate correction-scenario notebooks
nodes.rationale: Professor feedback reported by the user prompted retention. The student is excluded from the family-size count.

nodes.label: Family-size median correction provisional
nodes.source_location: Retain family size in separate correction-scenario notebooks
nodes.rationale: Estimate zero/missing sizes using positive recorded Pstatus plus guardian group medians, falling back to Pstatus then overall median. Round halves upward. Final adoption and clustering sensitivity remain pending.

nodes.label: Preserve positive family sizes including one
nodes.source_location: Retain family size in separate correction-scenario notebooks
nodes.rationale: Parental education and guardianship do not establish household membership. Size-1 observations are retained without forcing Pstatus T to imply two residents.

nodes.label: Historical family-size exclusion
nodes.rationale: Earlier working preprocessing dropped famsize. This describes the preserved historical pipeline. The 17 November retention scenario supersedes exclusion for its separate variants.

nodes.label: Zero-filled failures and absences
nodes.source_location: Missing failures and absences become zero
nodes.rationale: The user reconfirmed that blanks represent zero occurrences. Source confirmation of the export meaning remains pending.

nodes.label: Unknown Yes No category
nodes.rationale: Avoid assigning an assumed answer. There are 140 students with at least one unanswered Yes/No response. Later encoding must support a third category.

nodes.label: Recorded group keys for family medians
nodes.source_location: Retain family size in separate correction-scenario notebooks
nodes.rationale: Raw grouping keys prevent already imputed guardians from being used as observed household evidence.

nodes.label: School median study time
nodes.source_location: Grouped medians for study and travel time
nodes.rationale: Missing weekly study times use the recorded-school median before school is filled.

nodes.label: School address median travel time
nodes.source_location: Grouped medians for study and travel time
nodes.rationale: Missing travel time uses school and address group medians before those grouping variables are filled.

nodes.label: Unknown education differs from None
nodes.rationale: Unknown has no education rank. Literal None denotes no formal education and remains a recorded category.

nodes.label: Guardian mode mother
nodes.rationale: Eight missing guardians are filled with the observed mode mother in the existing working preprocessing.

nodes.label: Student dataset 649 rows 33 analytical features
nodes.rationale: The audited CSV has 34 imported columns including an exported row index. Excluding the index leaves 33 analytical features.

nodes.label: Literal education None parsing
nodes.rationale: Use keep_default_na=False and na_values=[empty string]. The audit records Medu blanks 27 and literal None 6, Fedu blanks 19 and literal None 7.

nodes.label: Zero family sizes need interpretation
nodes.rationale: 57 zeros and 3 missing family sizes are recorded. Household membership and count semantics need evidence.

nodes.label: Zero travel times uncertain
nodes.rationale: 29 zero travel times were observed. Zero can reflect rounding or data problems and has no confirmed cause.

nodes.label: Zero grades preserved as recorded
nodes.rationale: Grades range from zero to 19. A zero is a recorded value and requires interpretation before replacement.

nodes.label: Word notes are hypotheses
nodes.rationale: The Word notes contain preliminary proposals. Their education None absence claim conflicts with raw CSV categories.

nodes.label: No exact duplicate rows in audit
nodes.rationale: No exact duplicate rows were found with or without the exported index during the dated audit.

nodes.label: K-means baseline weak separation
nodes.rationale: The notebook reports two groups within candidates 2 to 5 with silhouette approximately 0.083. Final feature weighting and model selection remain pending.

nodes.label: DBSCAN noise and tiny group
nodes.rationale: The notebook reports 491 assigned students, 158 noise observations, and assigned groups of 486 and 5. Assigned-only silhouette covers a different population.

nodes.label: SOM topology requires review
nodes.rationale: The provisional 4 by 4 map reports topographic error about 0.550 and all 16 neurons occupied.

nodes.label: Unknown mode sensitivity ARI 0.963
nodes.rationale: The notebook reports ARI approximately 0.963 between Unknown and observed-mode Yes/No K-means scenarios under its fixed representation.

nodes.label: RFM requires dated event records
nodes.rationale: Static attributes and period grades lack dated event history and an appropriate value measure required for RFM.

nodes.label: One-hot and numeric distance weighting
nodes.source_location: cell 0 / Exploratory settings and inherited assumptions
nodes.rationale: Full one-hot nominal features can contribute squared distance 2, versus at most 1 for a scaled numerical feature. Weighting requires review.

nodes.label: Current education unknowns need model representation review
nodes.rationale: The experimental model asserts education categories belong to its five-level map, while current working preprocessing adds unknown. Reusing the newer prepared dataset requires compatibility review.
